# gitmoap_user_groups (Data Source)

List groups the user is a member of. Your own direct group memberships, with your role in each, newest first, at most 100 per page. Only the user themselves may list them.

The token needs `group_member:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `access_level` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `parent_group_id` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
- `visibility` (String)
